content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the kernel incorrectly interpreting the user-space values for the SO_RCVTIMEO and SO_SNDTIMEO socket options as 32-bit fields instead of the required 64-bit fields for the x32 ABI. This led to incorrect timeout values being set, particularly when the seconds portion of the timeout was less than 2^32, resulting in the microseconds portion being zero. Consequently, timeouts that should have been non-zero were treated as zero, causing the socket operations to never timeout as expected. The patch fixes this by ensuring that 64-bit time is used for these socket options as required by the ABI.

buggy_stmts_infos.buggy_stmt: return do_set_sock_timeout(sock, level, optname, optval, optlen);
return do_get_sock_timeout(sock, level, optname, optval, optlen);
